title: fix: enable Skill source lifecycle in paired-node workspaces
body:
Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-enterprise/issues/242

## What Problem This Solves

Skill source installation fails for paired-node workspaces even though Skill discovery and dependency installation work. Source records and ClawHub update/removal are also missing from that adapter.

## User Impact

Paired-node workspaces can install and track Skill sources, update ClawHub Skills, and remove them through the existing workspace lifecycle. Operators must allow the documented Skill and metadata paths. Installed files remain on the node.

## Why This Change Was Made

Connect the existing workspace contract to the native Skill workers. Gateway retains policy decisions and change hooks; the node owns source files, installation records, and temporary archive cleanup. Publication rechecks Gateway authority within the native installer's existing rollback boundaries. On cancellation, the node closes the installer's input and drains it so native rollback can restore a displaced Skill before exit; a 30-second forced-stop fallback bounds a stuck worker.

The added publication checkpoints are explicitly enabled by the node adapter. Existing SSH publishers retain their single policy reply and stdin-close protocol. Local installers keep their current path. This does not add channel menus or a new public uninstall API.

## Evidence

- Real Gateway/node authority proof: the installed-package fixture in `scripts/e2e/lib/paired-node-skills-authority/scenario.mjs` boots separate Gateway and paired-node processes and calls the normal upload/install RPCs. With uploads disabled, replacement is refused. For mid-publication revocation, a fixture-only preload pauses the second native publication checkpoint; the old target is already displaced into its backup. After `config.patch` disables uploads, releasing the checkpoint rejects replacement and restores the complete old Skill tree. Both ClawHub lockfiles remain absent (expected for archive uploads); backup, archive staging, and extraction directories are empty. No production hooks or policy changes were added.
- Run that release-only proof with `node scripts/e2e/lib/paired-node-skills-authority/scenario.mjs /absolute/path/to/installed/openclaw /new/artifact-directory`. The upload-revocation run passed in **9.79 s wall time including process cleanup** on the original candidate runtime. The extended run below adds operation cancellation. It performs no model calls and is not added to per-PR CI. Formatting, scoped script lint, and syntax checks pass.
- Cancellation regression (`3f5ab9d94f2`): the same installed-package scenario now also denies `workspace.skills` through `config.patch` after backup displacement. This triggers real Gateway/node cancellation. Before the fix the worker exited with the target missing and one backup remaining. After the fix the exact old tree is restored, the backup is removed, and archive/extraction staging is empty. The complete scenario passed in **22.93 s wall time**, including process cleanup, using the original installed core with the plugin rebuilt by the official plugin builder (candidate image `sha256:b3cabb55c8cc69e73f210b469e4e664a8244ab34d19c6e2b80ff9dd08968043a`). This is plugin-level cancellation proof, not another full OCE rollout. The 46 workspace/lifecycle regression tests passed in 35.41 s Vitest time; extension typecheck, scoped lint, formatting, and independent source review passed.
- Reproduced the original failure through a full local OCE deployment with a dedicated Codex Harness: upload succeeded, then `skills.install` reported remote installation unavailable.
- Final-image local acceptance: uploaded Skill v1 install/discovery/model use, v2 replacement/model use, and normal OCE redeployment with persisted v2 content. Gateway has no installed Skill copy.
- A synthetic HTTP ClawHub registry exercises native install, tracking, update, owner-edit refusal, and persistence. Removal uses the registered workspace adapter through the real Gateway/node transport, including the committed-change hook and file/lock/catalog cleanup. This is adapter removal proof, not the separate Claw package-deletion workflow or public registry availability.
- Full file-transfer plugin suite: 357 passed, 3 skipped, 27.94 s test execution (includes the new adapter tests).
- 243 focused native lifecycle/installer/adapter tests passed in 113.48 s. After the final SSH compatibility correction, all 7 directly affected tests passed in 36.06 s. Production core/extension and extension-test type lanes, scoped lint, formatting, and diff checks passed.
- One same-session model check initially reused the prior v1 answer without reading the updated Skill. Files and tracking were already v2; an explicit `skills_read` returned v2 in that same session. Final model checks require a fresh read; this change does not rewrite conversation history.
- Exact final-image SSH probe: one policy reply followed by stdin EOF successfully installs the Skill. Native filesystem checks and the runtime build passed. Independent review and autoreview found no remaining actionable P0/P1.

Local acceptance also exposed a separate OCE deployment-probe timeout: a respawned CLI child retained stdout after its parent was killed, leaving activation pending. The uploaded-Skill redeploy completed without intervention; the final ClawHub redeploy needed cleanup of that verified orphan probe before normal reconciliation could finish. After removing the test-only uninstall plugin, a further normal redeploy completed without intervention and a fresh model session read the persisted v2 Skill. Temporary source staging was empty. No probe implementation changes are included here.
